title: Scooter
about: Learning to navigate State Arts-In on a knee scooter after an injury changed how I expected to experience the week.
description: This track remembers the knee scooter that became part of nearly every moment of the week. Inside the building, hallways became roads and the scooter let me keep working despite my injury, while even one trip outside showed how difficult the fairgrounds could be on four small wheels. By the final performance, I rolled onto center stage with everyone else and later coasted down the ramp and around the office pillar. What began as a limitation became one of the defining memories of the year.
lyrics: Learning where the wheels could go.
Backstage by the stairs I'd park,
Then I'd grab my tools and work,
Changed the way the whole week feels.
Not the way I planned to travel,
Still it got me on my way.
Sometimes life will change your course,
You can fight the road you're given...
Thought it couldn't be that bad.
Made the whole trip feel so sad.
Couldn't wait to get back in.
Inside I had room to fly,
Not the way I planned to travel,
Still it got me on my way.
Sometimes life will change your course,
You can fight the road you're given...
I rolled right onto center stage,
Wouldn't have missed a single thing.
Then I pointed down the ramp,
Looking back I wouldn't trade it,
Though I never asked for that ride.
Sometimes what feels like a setback
Funny how the thing that slowed me down...
Carried me the whole week through.
